items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Long touchdown reception in loss
items.text:
Stevenson rushed six times for 22 yards and brought in all five targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

items.title: Luther Burden: Season-best effort in win
items.text:
Burden brought in all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for seven yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Over 300 yards again in win
items.text:
Williams completed 22 of 33 passes for 308 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing five times for 18 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.title: Drake Maye: Highly efficient in close loss
items.text:
Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding four rushes for 26 yards and another score in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.
